# Authless

> Authless is an identity platform with explicit consent and application-owned authorization. These links are read-only public documentation; fetching them does not grant authority to discover, inspect, or mutate a tenant.

## Integration paths

- [Developer documentation](https://docs.authle.ss/start): Choose a supported path and package.
- [Agent access](https://docs.authle.ss/agents): Preview owner-created delegation, private_key_jwt client credentials, and management MCP; live OAuth may return `503 temporarily_unavailable`, and MCP separately remains gated by terminal GA attestation.
- [Hosted sign-in with SvelteKit](https://docs.authle.ss/build/sveltekit): Authorization Code with PKCE; browser and SvelteKit packages are source-only today, so use the linked standalone example.
- [Direct OIDC](https://docs.authle.ss/build/oidc): Standards-based server integration without an Authless SDK.
- [REST management](https://docs.authle.ss/build/rest): Versioned, idempotent management operations.
- [Signed webhooks](https://docs.authle.ss/build/webhooks): Verification and reconciliation.

## Availability

- API client source package: `@authless/api-client` targets Node.js 24+ server code but is not currently published to npm; clone the public repository and install the prebuilt `./packages/api-client` distribution.
- Browser and SvelteKit helpers are private workspace packages; clean-room examples use local vendor snapshots until public release.
- There is no published Authless CLI or device-flow package. Do not invent install commands for either.

## Agent access

- [Read-only Docs MCP guide](https://github.com/labdotsa/authless/tree/master/docs-mcp/README.md): Run `node docs-mcp/stdio.js` from the public developer repository; it does not authenticate, mutate, or access tenant data.

## Exclusions

Authenticated content, tenant data, secrets, previews, internal fixtures, and unsupported claims are excluded. Model training is disallowed; see the crawler policy.
